[h2]Hello, fearfolks![/h2]

We're super excited to announce that [b]Perseverance: Part 3 IS AVAILABLE NOW![/b]

Perseverance: Part 3 is the latest and final episode of the drama/horror visual novel series where you will make over [b]200 plot-influencing choices[/b], and the only thing juicier than the gossip are the guts being spilled left and right. In Part 3, [b]you can choose to play as Jack or Karen[/b] and help them form an unlikely alliance to face the overbearing danger as a team.

[b]Go on and check it out. We're launching the game with a 15% launch discount![/b]

[b]Cheers!
Titanite Games & Feardemic[/b]

notes.title: A welcome, a trailer, and a demo - Perseverence Part 3
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/231783b2686b111d50fc07b4e720f6e466a7d14b.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, drama lovers![/h2]

Hope you’re having a lovely May, we certainly are. We had just released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367460/Perseverance_Part_2/]Part 2 of Perseverance[/url] last month and made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/854870/Perseverance_Part_1/]Part 1 free to play[/url], [b]and we’re already back with more because we just couldn’t wait to share it with you![/b] As you may already know if you’ve watched [b]Feardemic’s Fear Fest[/b], we’ve been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/]Perseverance: Part 3[/url], and we’re finally ready to spill more tea about what’s next for Jack and Karen. 

As you may have gathered, in this one both of the main characters from the previous entries make a comeback, but, [b]here’s the twist[/b], for the first time, you get to choose which one of them you'd like to experience the story as. It’s also a culmination of a lot of work on this and previous games, so we’re really proud of what we’ve accomplished.

[b]You can read all the deets on the Perseverance: Part 3 Steam Store page or you can watch this brand new Reveal Trailer[/b] we’ve prepared just for this occasion. We’re super thrilled to share this with you, so let us know your thoughts in the comments because we love hearing from you and it gives us the motivation to keep going, and your feedback helps us create a better game. Now, without further ado, the Reveal Trailer for Perseverance: Part 3:

[previewyoutube=vLnJUUWTQ40;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Excited? Hungry for more? Well, we’ve got you covered[/b]. If you simply can’t wait to see what’s coming in the Perseverance series, you can check out the [b]FREE demo[/b] that we have just released. Simply click the Play Game button on the Perseverance: Part 3 Store Page and get right back to Grey Ville for your scheduled drama injection. [b]Oh, and while you’re on that page, don’t forget to add Part 3 to your Wishlist, to make sure you’ll never miss an update or any juicy gossip:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/1482a96bd7d90d54abbf6625a6ad3b4ab43ccb7a.jpg[/img]

Speaking of gossip, let us know in the comments and on Twitter, whether you’re [b]#TeamJack[/b] or [b]#TeamKaren[/b], we’re excited to hear who you’ll be playing as! Make sure to tag [b]@feardemic[/b] and [b]@TitaniteNovels[/b] as well so we can see your tweets more easily. If you’d like to talk about the game and argue about which character is better, make sure to hop on [url=https://discord.gg/yTaJkdDKtY]Feardemic Discord[/url] and join the conversation there!


[b]Catch you next time, Fearfolks![/b]

notes.title: Demo available. Stream is coming. Perseverance has persevered.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/eafd17d57cc8b1b71fe0b04213ddf5fd70e45bc2.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, drama lovers![/h1]

[h2]Play the new demo for Part 2 of Perseverance! Watch the stream on Thursday 24.02.2022, at 6 PM CET / 9 AM PDT, and play along or sit back and enjoy the show![/h2]

[b]It’s Steam Next Fest o’clock[/b] and we’re happy to announce that Perseverance has in fact persevered and we have a demo for Part 2 of our thrilling visual novel, locked, loaded, and ready for you to play it. Simply press on the ‘play demo’ button and you’ll be able to download the game and take our creepy, blood-soaked baby for a spin. That came out wrong… 

Bottom line: the demo is here and we really hope you like it because we’ve worked very hard on it and can’t wait to hear your opinions and feedback. We’re nothing without our community so if you play it, please leave a comment and describe your experience, we’d love to hear from you. In a similar vein, if you enjoyed the demo, make sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/854870/Perseverance_Part_1/]Part 1 of the Perseverance series[/url] and tap that wishlist button on the top of the page. It really goes a long way and, hey, if you already like it, what’s the hurt in that?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/dcaffda6192c5c37a968f978b7b86da4234a73e3.png[/img]

If you don’t have time to play the demo yourself or are in any way unable to run it, fear not, Lottie from Feardemic will be playing it on stream, here on top of the store page, on [b]Thursday 24.02.2022, at 6 PM CET / 9 AM PDT[/b]. You are free to watch and chat or to play along on a 2nd device/ monitor. See you there!

Well, that’s it for now! Once again, we hope you’ll enjoy the demo and write down your impressions! See you on stream or in the comment section.

[b]Ciao, and kind regards
Titanite Games & Feardemic[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367460/Perseverance_Part_2/

notes.title: New character and UI design
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/dc748ae5f46dff6361e0c0366ec9bf68774cdd13.png[/img]
[h2][b]Hello friends,[/b][/h2]
[h3]
Some good news for you! [/h3]

[b]We have introduced a huge update to our game, which includes:[/b]
- new character design: Jack, Natalie, and Hope, who will also appear in parts two and three! (more on that later),
- A new menu and UI which introduces several new features to the game,
- All language improvements in English and French.

We moved the entire game from the Fungus tool to Naninovel. This allowed us to add many new functions to the game. 

However, there was one issue we wanted to inform you about. All your current game saves will be deleted. We are very sorry for that.

Let's start with the characters, below is a comparison with the new (right) and old design

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/d2b6223caabc04320e8c264b10d4dfcb636a1f83.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/c49a9afd289b74cff8566b8b85e88181a627882f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/1413060439a6bc6263cea408ae0313a1ec4787a6.png[/img]

Our characters appear in several emotional states: suspicious, angry, happy, neutral, sad, scared, shocked. For the graphics, we used single emotions, so the rest awaits you in the game!

                        [u]                                                                                                                [/u]

This is how the characters look in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/d980b768388fb432a190ae632667984c5f54a697.png[/img]

The screenshot also shows off the new UI, which has several new features. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/6f210b0cb4dc321e7b55484ad93a6dda67f1a926.png[/img]

LOG - allows you to read all spoken dialog, choices made, or narration. It is, in other words, the history of the textual content (as seen below).

Other useful features include - auto/skip mode - which will automatically scroll the text (speed can be adjusted in options). 

Using q.save and quick loads you will be able to quickly save and load the game without having to enter the save menu.

We have also introduced a forward and backward text scrolling feature using the wheel on your mouse,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/0251206d4daec57ee67b52b9b38de3ff165f8ea8.png[/img]

Regarding proofreading, thanks to the amazing help of one of the players, Yoann, our English, and French game is completely bug-free. The whole Titanite Games team (and surely a lot of players!) are very grateful for this help. Thank you!

One last piece of information for you. The release of Part: 2 will officially take place after the Steam Festival, so in March 2022! We also officially want to let you know about Part: 3, which will be released two weeks after Part: 2! We are currently in the final stages of production.

Both parts (+ part 1) will also be released on Nintendo Switch at the same time! That's why the release of Part: 2 was postponed, because the game required a port to Nintendo Switch, and also we had to set all the release details with NS.

         [url=https://discord.com/invite/D5eEzD6g7G][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/9c30e8c745d0d54f5a4a9c510167a791b8e3f47c.png[/img][/url]


Regards,
Titanite Games

notes.title: Remastered Part: 1 - release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/fbe81e51eab7f9b9b2cc8bf4dd0078bd155d1ec3.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello :)[/b][/h2]

A new light falls on Grey Ville!

Today we bring you the first part of the well-known and beloved visual novel - Perseverance: Part 1 in a new and refreshed graphic style.

[h3]The refreshed version of the game has just been released![/h3] And is fully prepared for you to experience Jack's story once again. With the new graphical style, we wanted to give you the opportunity to play the first part in the same graphical style as Perseverance: Part 2, which will also be released soon. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/44aac4e4da10bacc4487c14c7c3b58e41a31c156.png[/img]


Today is also the end of the giveaway (on our discord channel) - where you can win a Steam key to Perseverance: Part 1. Results will be announced on March 1.

if you missed it, check out the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/854870/view/3042715219435217905]devlog[/url].

That's all for today :) We wish you a lot of fun with the refreshed Perseverance: Part 1.

notes.title: Check out refreshed Part 1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello friends :)[/b][/h2]

Our forge is as busy as ever. Perseverance: Part 2 is coming closer and closer to its completion which brings us closer to launch. The results of our hard work so far are pretty awesome. Meanwhile, our team has prepared a noteworthy surprise! In March 2021, you will be able to experience Perseverance: Part 1 in a new and fresh visual style.

Remember Jack? It’s hard to forget a troubled father trying as hard as he can to keep his family together. Today, Jack has finally blushed with some colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/d46b283874ad54396e3c02ed325594cce3660a65.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/40d124578756afca8cd7a1eb71bfdb5b98607339.png[/img]

If Jack became more colorful, his Natalie deserves a stylish treatment as well. Being a part of an explosive marriage one can be stunned and terrified by a situation. The refreshment of Natalie's character made her emotion and reaction even more believable and scary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/53631d40f9c0aeb300faf82e87c3d22aa9f293aa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32929210/2b6167f0403a1d522ad447a5d02aa35ae9f8e2cc.jpg[/img]

We wanted Perseverance: Part 1 to step up to the visual quality set by its successor. In Perseverance: Part you finally get to play as Karen and witness her side of the story prior to all hell breaking loose in GreyVille.

[previewyoutube=Q8Q7qXxzG8c;full][/previewyoutube]

Regards,
Titanite Games
